product_one_liner.value: Advocate uses AI to standardize commercial insurance policy data, benchmark coverage and pricing, and monitor portfolio risk for brokers, loan servicers, carriers, and property owners.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes standardizing policy data and benchmarking it against market transactions, identifies the four customer groups, and describes AI agents and continuous portfolio-risk monitoring. Sources: https://linkedin.com/company/advocate-technologies and https://trust.advocate.app/subprocessors

pricing_page.notes: A public pricing page lists an Enterprise Custom offering with contact-sales pricing; numerical prices are not required by the question. Source: https://advocate.app/pricing

named_customers.notes: named_customers: KeyBank and Greystone appear in the homepage customer-logo display. The evidence is a logo wall rather than separate customer case studies. Source: https://advocate.app/ | named_customers.0: KeyBank is named in the homepage customer-logo display. Source: https://advocate.app/ | named_customers.1: Greystone is named in the homepage customer-logo display. Source: https://advocate.app/

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 74 employees, placing it in the 51-100 band. Profile-based headcount may differ from official payroll headcount. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/advocate-technologies

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company explicitly states that it is headquartered in New York City. Source: https://www.advocate.app/about | hq_country: The about page identifies New York City as headquarters, and the company profile identifies its country as the United States. Sources: https://www.advocate.app/about and https://linkedin.com/company/advocate-technologies

founded_year.notes: The company profile explicitly lists 2020 as its founding year. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/advocate-technologies

eng_blog.notes: The blog index contains one company-news post announcing funding and commercial-insurance benchmarks, rather than two engineer-authored articles about building the product. It therefore does not meet the specified engineering-blog threshold. Source: https://www.advocate.app/blog

public_docs.notes: The public API documentation contains multiple articles, including Authentication, Query Parameters, Responses, Errors, Rate Limiting, and Custom Metadata. Source: https://docs.advocate.app/

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The job board lists five openings: Platform Engineer, two Product Engineer roles, Client Solutions Manager, and Insurance Consultant. None has a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title. Source: https://ats.rippling.com/en-GB/advocate-technologies-inc/jobs

model_provider.notes: The security page explicitly names Anthropic and OpenAI as frontier-model providers used for inference under zero-data-retention enterprise agreements. Source: https://www.advocate.app/security

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The security page claims an available SOC 2 Type II report and an information-security management system certified against ISO/IEC 27001:2022. Neither is described as in progress. Source: https://www.advocate.app/security | compliance_certs.0: The security page explicitly claims SOC 2 Type II with a report available. Source: https://www.advocate.app/security | compliance_certs.1: The security page states that the information-security management system is certified against ISO/IEC 27001:2022. Source: https://www.advocate.app/security

raised_18mo.notes: The August 4, 2026 announcement reports $18 million in seed funding, within the 18 months preceding November 9, 2026. Source: https://www.advocate.app/blog/advocate-raises-18-million-commercial-insurance-benchmarks

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: None of the five listed openings is an SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative, or account executive role. Source: https://ats.rippling.com/en-GB/advocate-technologies-inc/jobs

launched_6mo.notes: Advocate announced its public launch and standardized pricing-and-coverage benchmarks on August 4, 2026, within the six months preceding November 9, 2026. Source: https://www.advocate.app/blog/advocate-raises-18-million-commercial-insurance-benchmarks

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Unknown: no dated qualifying C-level or VP arrival or departure was verified for the requested window, and the about page did not provide a complete named leadership roster with start dates. This does not establish a negative answer. Reviewed page: https://www.advocate.app/about

crm_stack_signal.notes: Readable job descriptions refer only to unnamed CRM platforms and third-party integrations. The reviewed documentation and jobs did not identify a specific CRM or sales-and-marketing system, so the result is an empty list, not a claim that no such software is used.
